Wolters Kluwer Health is seeking a Product Software Engineer to design, build, test, automate, and improve software for healthcare professionals and engineering teams. The role contributes to healthcare applications and AI-enabled product experiences or to cloud, automation, and engineering tools, while developing hands-on software engineering experience.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain reliable software
Translate product and technical requirements into working solutions
Write and maintain automated tests that protect expected software behavior
Troubleshoot technical issues using logs, test results, telemetry, and other available evidence
Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from experienced engineers
Use source control and established software development practices to manage and deliver code changes
Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, quality teams, clinical domain experts, and other technical partners
Improve the performance, reliability, readability, security, and maintainability of existing systems
Learn and apply new programming languages, frameworks, cloud technologies, and development tools
Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully for coding, testing, debugging, and documentation
Validate AI-generated code and verify software behavior before release
Follow secure software development practices and help protect sensitive data
Develop features across web applications, APIs, shared services, and AI-enabled workflows
Build and test integrations between applications and services
Contribute to AI-enabled product experiences that help healthcare professionals access and apply trusted clinical information
Support streamed responses, agent workflows, and other connected product experiences
Diagnose application defects and make focused improvements to stability and usability
Develop tools that support build, release, testing, security scanning, and deployment processes
Contribute to continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines using Jenkins or similar technologies
Help build and maintain automation for development, testing, and production environments
Gain experience with Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and infrastructure as code
Support tools and processes that improve developer productivity and software delivery
Assist with automating application deployments across cloud and on-premises environments

Required
Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field
Academic, personal, or professional experience developing software in at least one programming language, such as Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C++, C#, Groovy, or a similar language
Understanding of foundational software development concepts
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to break down technical problems, evaluate possible solutions, and ask questions when requirements are unclear
Interest in learning new technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices
Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively in a team environment
Commitment to software quality, security, accountability, and continuous learning
Preferred
Experience with Git or another source-control platform
Exposure to unit, integration, end-to-end, or automated testing
Familiarity with APIs, web applications, microservices, or connected software systems
Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services
Familiarity with CI/CD, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, or infrastructure-as-code technologies
Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or similar technologies
Interest in healthcare technology, clinical decision support, artificial intelligence, cloud engineering, developer tools, or DevOps
